component.name: TaskMonitor
component.summary: A modern task manager for Linux

description.p: TaskMonitor shows everything Windows Task Manager does, for Linux: apps and background processes with CPU, memory, disk and GPU use; live performance graphs for every CPU core, memory, disk, network adapter and GPU; services, startup apps, signed-in users and per-app history.
End, suspend or reprioritise processes, set CPU affinity or put a process in efficiency mode, start and stop services, and choose which apps start at sign-in.
Make the whole interface bigger or smaller with Ctrl+Plus, Ctrl+Minus and Ctrl+0, or in Settings.
ARM64 packages, and an option to keep running in the background with live stats in the top bar.
App icons, CPU/RAM/GPU in the top bar, a Disk activity card, disk read and write columns, copyable process properties, a redesigned Settings page and an update checker.
Fixes installing the RPM on Fedora 44, adds the MIT License and an About section.
